title: Consolidate component docs and migration patterns for tokens, buttons, tables, charts
creator: Maya Chen
description: Goal: Replace scattered component guidance with a single, opinionated documentation flow that covers design tokens, button variants, table patterns, and chart usage. This ticket scopes the content rewrite, migration notes for engineers, and a lightweight API reference for each component. Focus is on examples, clear do/don'ts, migration steps from legacy tokens and class-based components, and copy suitable for the docs site.
acceptance_criteria: A unified docs section exists on the docs site with pages: Tokens Overview, Buttons (API + patterns), Tables (usage + accessibility), Charts (data examples + sizing)
Migration notes included for tokens v1 -> v2 and buttons v1 -> tokens-based variants with automated codemod suggestions
At least 6 real-world examples (usage snippets) across components and a clear set of do/don't patterns
Engineering sign-off on API examples and code snippets; design review passed in Figma file linked in comments
CI link to docs site staging shows new pages and no broken anchors; deployment scheduled in release design-system-2026.03
deliverables: Tokens page with mapping table (legacy token -> new token) and migration checklist
Buttons page: API props, visual variants, recommended sizes, accessibility notes, and examples
Tables page: compositional API, pagination examples, responsive behaviors, sorting and keyboard patterns
Charts page: recommended chart types for common use-cases, sizing grid, and example datasets
Codemod proposals and example PRs that update class names and token usage
Hand-off notes for engineering with estimated rollback plan and testing checklist
migration_notes: Summary: Legacy tokens (color-*, spacing-*, font-*) are being consolidated into the new token set (ui-color-*, spacing-base, type-scale-*). Migration steps: 1) run token-report script to identify usages; 2) apply codemod/codemod-preview to map names; 3) update any custom CSS overrides to use new tokens; 4) regressively test pages listed in the migration checklist. Buttons: convert legacy size props to size tokens, replace .btn-{ghost|primary} classes with <Button variant="..."> API. Tables and charts: refactor local styles to use token-based spacings and color fills. Known gotchas: theme overrides in Dedicated deployments may include hard-coded hex values; coordinate with infra if HSM/KMS-based theming is in use.
examples:
Button (React)
import { Button } from '@redwood/ui';
<Button variant="primary" size="md">Create snapshot</Button>
Notes: prefer size tokens ("sm", "md", "lg") and avoid setting explicit padding in consumers.

Table (JSX)
<Table columns={cols} data={rows} pagination={{ pageSize: 25 }} />
Accessibility: ensure aria-rowcount is set for virtualized lists.

Chart (pseudo)
<BarChart data={salesByRegion} width={600} height={320} role="img" aria-label="Sales by region" />
Sizing: use breakpoint-aware width tokens; avoid fixed pixel heights for mobile.

Tokens usage mapping snippet
/* legacy */ var(--color-primary-600)  => /* new */ var(--ui-color-brand-600)
api_docs_summary: For each component page include: 1) API table listing props and types, 2) default tokens consumed, 3) example of composition with other primitives (Icon, Tooltip), 4) migration snippet for backwards compatibility. Keep examples runnable in the docs sandbox with snapshot tests referenced in the associated PR.
rollout_plan: Draft content authored in docs branch: docs/refactor-component-docs
Design review in Figma and inline comments (link in comments) - address feedback
Engineering PR to update code snippets and introduce codemod scripts - include test fixtures
Merge to staging and cross-team review (PM, Eng, Security) - 3 business days
Release to production docs during maintenance window and publish migration guide announcement
